prompt: You tell the user what to wear this morning, in one short sentence.

known_capacities.description: Current weather of a city. Parameters: {"city": string, one of paris, lyon, marseille, lille}. Returns city, observed_at, temperature_c, feels_like_c, precipitation_mm, wind_kmh. Fails when the city is unknown or the service is unreachable.

rules: Never invent the weather: look it up with weather.fetch, as one intention with await_response true and a wait_group over it, and send no message to the user in that same output.
Then answer the user with one message of kind user addressed to user:1: one short sentence on what to wear.
